_doc: Adventurer ranks F -> S (RankManager.gd, docs/design/GAME_ROADMAP.md section 3). To be promoted you need the next rank's Guild Points, fewer than settings.demerit_block demerits, and to finish its promotion trial (a special Guild bounty with no deadline). Perks: floor_cap (highest floor you can unlock; 0 = no cap), carry_limit, board_size, max_active, reward_mult (bounty gold), party_size (recruit slots, used once parties exist). Recipes with unlock {type: adventurer_rank, rank: X} are known from rank X.

F.title: Fledgling
F.description: Fresh off the road with a borrowed blade. The Guild lets you take small jobs.

E.title: Wayfarer
E.description: You've proven you can come back alive.

trial.title: Trial of the Wood
trial.description: Defeat the warband leader of the Goblin Forest on floor 3 or deeper.

D.title: Pathfinder
D.description: Trusted to go deeper. Other adventurers start to know your name.

trial.title: Trial of the Deep Ice
trial.description: Defeat a troll king in the Troll Caves on floor 6 or deeper.

C.title: Vanguard
C.description: The Guild sends you where the trouble is.

trial.title: Trial of the Warband
trial.description: Defeat an orc warlord on the Orc Plains, floor 10 or deeper.

B.title: Veteran
B.description: Seasoned and scarred. Recruits ask to follow you.

trial.title: Trial of the Circle
trial.description: Defeat the ruler of the Fairy Circles on floor 14 or deeper.

A.title: Champion
A.description: One of the Guild's finest. Bards get your name almost right.

trial.title: Trial of the Labyrinth
trial.description: Defeat the boss of floor 18 or deeper in The Dungeon.

S.title: Legend
S.description: Songs are sung. Rivals measure themselves against you.

trial.title: Trial of Legends
trial.description: Defeat the boss of floor 23 or deeper in The Dungeon.
